messages:
emily_sales: OrionCare asked for a concise benchmark and a cost delta for reserved vs burst for their pilot. Baseline target = 260 rps steady, microbursts to 1400 rps for 45s every 12m. They want SAML + privatelink for the trial and a one-page cost breakout. Can we lock a run plan + quick token estimate for a 24h window?
ryan_perf: Proposed test phases: warmup/cache-fill (20m @ 35%), steady (90m @ 260rps), burst block (20 cycles 45s@1400rps spaced 12m), long soak (6h @ 120rps). Capture p50/p95/p99, batch hist, queue time, gpu util, and KV-cache hit.
ryan_perf: Runner example: ```rbench --model redwood-70b-int8-v1 --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --qps 260 --concurrency 104 --duration 5400 --burst-pattern "1400@45s:every12m" --warmup 1200 --record-batch-hist```
aj_infra: Infra plan: provision two pools (steady + burst autoscaler). Allocating 8 x a100-like nodes for the window and a canary route to redwood-13b-quant for automated fallback. I'll schedule sandbox for 2027-12-07 09:00 PT -> 2027-12-08 09:00 PT.
claire_sec: Minimal shareable checklist: IdP metadata XML (SAML 2.0), list of test admin users, corporate IPs for privatelink/VPC allowlist, desired region, HSM needed? We can provide KMS-managed keys quickly; BYO-HSM adds onboarding. SOC2/ISO reports available.
tom_ae: Cost ask: give me token estimate for the 24h mixed run and a monthly reserved vs on-demand delta for baseline 260rps. Need a one-slide summary for procurement.
ryan_perf: Quick token math (estimate): assume 48 tokens/request average. Tokens/hr = 260 * 48 * 3600 = 45,158,400 tokens/hr. For a representative 18h weighted mix (warmup + steady + bursts + soak) ~813M tokens. Using unit $0.00072 per 1k tokens => token cost ~ $586. Add ~12% burst compute overhead -> total run ~ $657. Reserved baseline pricing (monthly commit sized for 260rps) would reduce per-token unit ~28%; bursts billed at on-demand with small premium. I'll drop a short table.
bench-bot: [system] Provisioning scheduled: 8 x a100-like instances allocated to sales-sandbox 2027-12-07 09:00 PT -> 2027-12-08 09:00 PT. Artifacts path: /shared/sales/orioncare/2156789012/
ryan_perf: Metrics to capture: p50/p90/p95/p99, tokens_per_request, batch_size_hist, request_queue_ms, gpu_util_pct, kv_cache_hit_pct, and per-route errors. Also capture per-request prompt length to normalize cost.
ryan_perf: I'll run a quick smoke in ~30m and post numbers. If p99 > 600ms during bursts we should increase batching.max_wait_ms to 25ms and bump batching.max_tokens to 96.
bench-bot: [system] Smoke complete: 15m warmup + 10m steady @260rps -> p95=230ms, p99=480ms, kv_cache_hit=81%. Artifacts uploaded: /shared/sales/orioncare/2156789012/smoke.csv
aj_infra: Reaction: steady looks healthy. For bursts we expect p99 bump to ~700-900ms; we'll run the full burst soak with the increased max_wait setting and upload results.
emily_sales: Great. Claire  please paste the minimal security snippet I can send to procurement. Ryan/Tom  once you post the cost slide I'll send to the customer and propose 99% uptime SLA for the POC window with an automated fallback to 13b within 5m if sustained p95 breach.
claire_sec: Pasteable snippet: "We support SAML 2.0 (provide IdP metadata XML), temporary privatelink/VPC peering (provide corporate IP ranges), KMS-managed keys for tenant data. BYO-HSM supported with additional onboarding. SOC2 & ISO27001 attestations available on request."
tom_ae: I'll draft the one-slide summary after you upload the cost table. Planning to include: run plan, token cost ~$657 (incl bursts), reserved discount example (~28% lower unit price), and 99% POC uptime SLA.
emily_sales: Thanks team  I'll wait for the burst soak artifacts then email OrionCare.
